resources.string: Microphone access lets you speak in live classes and record spoken answers in BrenUp learning activities.
Camera access lets you share your video during BrenUp live classes.

BrenUp will share the screen or app you choose with participants in your live class. A system capture indicator remains visible. Stop sharing in BrenUp or, when shown, from the Android capture notification.

BrenUp will record the screen or app you choose with live-class audio, including your mic when it is on. The recording stays in this app on this device. A system capture indicator remains visible; stop in BrenUp or, when shown, from the Android capture notification.
